text: LIFE IN BHUTAN THE MYSTERIOUS HIMALAYAN KINGDOM WHERE HAPPINESS COMES FIRST Imagine living in a country hidden high in the Himalayas, where enormous mountains surround small villages, ancient monasteries sit above deep valleys, and forests cover much of the landscape. Imagine a place where television and the internet arrived only recently, where traditional clothing is still part of everyday life, and where a national policy once made the world ask a strange question. Can a country measure its success by happiness instead of money? This is Bhutan. A small Himalayan kingdom located between India and China.
